cookiecutter.name: maps
cookiecutter.description: Places and spatial questions: geocode (a place name to a point: the brain's own located entities first, then a cache, then OpenStreetMap's Nominatim, public names only), the views places_near and notes_near, map layers (layers/*.yaml, read-only queries the HBI's Map panel draws) with places added by hand, and ship (aisstream.io) and aircraft (OpenSky) tracks over watch areas (areas/*.yaml) with area_traffic, every count with its coverage.
